name: navbar-with-search
title: Navbar with search
description: A navbar built around a search field that opens your command palette, with an icon button in its place on a phone.
docs: The field is a real button: it calls onSearchOpen, so open your own command palette or search overlay there and the bar keeps no search logic. It shows the shortcut for the platform (the Command symbol on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere) with the letter from shortcutKey, and the shortcut works anywhere on the page, also below lg where the field gives way to an icon button named by searchLabel. Under md the links move into a sheet with the actions at its foot. onSearchOpen is a function, so use the bar from a Client Component, next to the palette it opens. Pass linkAs={Link} for your router's links and currentHref to mark the current page, and navLabel and menuLabel to name the navigation landmark and the phone menu (its button and its sheet).
